title: Stats
intro: Every number for a group, for teams and players: all maps, one map, or the maps you pick. While a map is being played, it shows the table with that map added, the same table the live overlays and AFC LIVE show.
pickGroupFirst: Pick a group to see its numbers.
noGroups: This event has no groups yet.

live.title: Map {n} is live
live.alive: {count, plural, one {# team still in} other {# teams still in}}
live.intro: The group's table with the map being played added, refreshed every 5 seconds. Points for this map are provisional until its result is uploaded.
live.unmatched: On the map but not in this group: {names}
live.mapMvp: MVP of this map so far:

empty: No map in this choice has a result yet.
search: Search a player, team or UID
notOnRosterWhy: UID {uid} played for this team but is not on its roster. Their kills count for the team; add them to the roster or approve them in Flagged players.
pendingWhy: Matched to this player by in-game name, not UID. Approve it in Flagged players.

scope.all: {count, plural, =0 {No map of the group has a result yet.} one {All of the group's # map with a result.} other {All of the group's # maps with a result.}}
scope.some: {count, plural, one {# map picked.} other {# maps picked.}}

errors.load: The numbers could not be loaded. Try again.
errors.download: The download did not work. Try again.

session.help: When the last map of the day has been played, mark it so AFC Capture and AFC LIVE know the games are over for now.
session.doneHelp: AFC Capture and AFC LIVE show that the games are over for now. The mark goes by itself when the next map is played.
session.markDone: That was the last map for now
session.failed: The mark could not be saved. Try again.
